response.sql: WITH per_budget AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM per_budget), above AS (SELECT p.total_cost, p.expense_count FROM per_budget p JOIN avg_spend a ON p.total_cost > a.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM above) AS avg_total_above, (SELECT SUM(expense_count) FROM above) AS total_expenses, (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM above) - (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_spend) AS avg_excess_over_average;
